audit.whatIsWrong: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability. It is fabricated, and the page uses it as her matchup-defining spell in focus.text, loading, winCon, enemyWin, ahead, breakdown.mid/cooldowns/spikes/feeding/difficulty/trading, dosFull[0..2], report[3], report[5], report[9], report[10], report[12] and report[13]. The packet's own defect list confirms the page never names a single real Ambessa ability.
audit.why: Her real kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q, 14s at rank 1), Repudiation (W, 18s), Lacerate (E, 13s) and Public Execution (R, 130s at rank 1). The matchup-defining cast is Public Execution: per Riot's text she blinks to the FARTHEST enemy champion in a line of her choosing, suppresses on arrival, then slams for damage and a stun. Standing nearest to her means the ult takes someone else — a concrete positioning rule the page could never give while the ability had no name.
audit.corrected: Every instance replaced with Public Execution, with its 130s rank-1 cooldown and the farthest-target-in-line behaviour written into report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns. Repudiation's shield-and-amplify and Drakehound's Step's auto-reset tell written into dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers print the chart as Skill / Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Skill / Fiora / Fiora. The packet reads Fiora / Skill / Skill / Fiora / Ambessa / Ambessa / Fiora, and the packet matches the written reasons at every row: whys[0] 'your Q-Vital poke wins the short trade' (Fiora), whys[1] and whys[2] both open with 'Even' (Skill), whys[3] 'this window is yours' (Fiora), whys[4] 'she wins the extended fight at 6' (Ambessa), whys[5] 'her item-1 spike lets her edge the extended trade' (Ambessa), whys[6] 'you re-take the duel' (Fiora).
audit.why: Six of seven rows printed a side its own explanation contradicts — including telling the player level 6 is even when the text underneath says she wins it.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Fiora 6 / Skill 5 / Skill 5 / Fiora 6 / Ambessa 4 / Ambessa 4 / Fiora 7 in both layers, with phases[0..5].why rewritten to state each new side.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why said 'Ravenous Hydra is your spike — force fights the moment it completes' on a row that belongs to Ambessa's first item, and phases[4].why said your Grand Challenge 'wins any committed duel' on the row where she has Public Execution.
audit.why: Both told the player to commit into the two windows the enemy owns.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now keys the level-6 row to Public Execution's 130s cooldown and the Riposte bait; phases[5].why now names her bruiser item and the dash-weaving that dodges Vitals.

notes: This matchup's biggest defect was a fabricated ability name — 'Repeating Dashes' appeared in 19 strings as Ambessa's matchup-defining spell and does not exist. All replaced with Public Execution. I did NOT tell the player that Repudiation or Public Execution ground her target: the kit file carries grounding flags on both, but Riot's own descriptions of the two abilities say nothing about grounding, and per the rules the description wins. Same for healing: report[8].t and breakdown.late tell the player to buy Executioner's Calling because 'his healing fights your pattern' — the kit flags heal on Public Execution but Riot's text for it mentions no heal, so I left both strings untouched rather than reinforce an unverified claim. Both are worth a hand check. The content layer also credits her ult with armour-pen-style scaling in places; I left that alone too.
